{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-2ead9532-3738-45f9-910a-8b1560bc1f12-25","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'\nimport json, urllib.request, datetime\nurl='https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=BTCUSDT&interval=5m&limit=80'\nreq=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})\nwith urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:\n    data=json.load(r)\nprint('n', len(data))\n# print from 03:00 UTC\nfor c in data:\n    t=datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(c[0]/1000)\n    if t >= datetime.datetime(2026,10,13,3,0):\n        print(t.strftime('%H:%M'), 'O', round(float(c[1])), 'H', round(float(c[2])), 'L', round(float(c[3])), 'C', round(float(c[4])))\n# day stats since 00:00 UTC and since 04:00 UTC (midnight ET)\ndef stats(start):\n    xs=[c for c in data if datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(c[0]/1000)>=start]\n    if not xs: \n        print('no', start); return\n    hi=max(float(c[2]) for c in xs)\n    lo=min(float(c[3]) for c in xs)\n    op=float(xs[0][1])\n    cl=float(xs[-1][4])\n    print(start, 'open', round(op), 'high', round(hi), 'low', round(lo), 'last', round(cl), 'bars', len(xs))\nstats(datetime.datetime(2026,10,13,0,0))\nstats(datetime.datetime(2026,10,13,4,0))\n# also daily from binance\nurl2='https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=BTCUSDT&interval=1h&limit=30'\nreq2=urllib.request.Request(url2, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})\nwith urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=15) as r:\n    h=json.load(r)\nprint('--- hourly ---')\nfor c in h:\n    t=datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(c[0]/1000)\n    print(t.strftime('%m-%d %H:%M'), 'O', round(float(c[1])), 'H', round(float(c[2])), 'L', round(float(c[3])), 'C', round(float(c[4])))\nPY","description":"Fetch Binance BTC candles for Oct 13"},"content":[],"locations":[]}

{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-11ea8950-742d-443c-acc1-896c41bd030f-28","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'\nimport math, random\nrandom.seed(7)\n# hourly closes from the binance print, compute sigma\nhours = [\n(83963,83668),(83668,83836),(83836,83613),(83613,84149),(84149,84022),(84022,84224),\n(84224,83992),(83992,83506),(83506,83556),(83556,83501),(83501,83397),(83397,82759),\n(82759,82969),(82969,82592),(82592,82730),(82730,82511),(82511,82504),(82504,82448),\n(82448,82862),(82862,83097),(83097,82574),(82574,82158),(82158,81850),(81850,81443),\n(81443,82442),(82442,82930),(82930,83331),(83331,83454),(83454,83682),(83682,83638)\n]\nrets=[math.log(c/o) for o,c in hours]\nmu=sum(rets)/len(rets)\nvar=sum((r-mu)**2 for r in rets)/(len(rets)-1)\nsig=math.sqrt(var)\nprint('hourly mu', mu, 'sig', sig, 'sig_pct', sig*100, 'n', len(rets))\n\n# simulate remaining path\n# BTC levels from spot 83638, 22 hours (until 04:00 UTC Oct 14)\n# 4h window: 1.83 hours left, open 83331, spot 83638\nN=20000\n\ndef sim_hit(hours, spot, barriers_up, barriers_dn, n=N):\n    # returns prob touch each barrier\n    up_hits={b:0 for b in barriers_up}\n    dn_hits={b:0 for b in barriers_dn}\n    for i in range(n):\n        p=spot\n        mx=p\n        mn=p\n        for h in range(hours):\n            r=random.gauss(mu, sig)\n            p*=math.exp(r)\n            # intrabar range approx: high/low within hour using extra noise\n            w=abs(random.gauss(0, sig*0.6))\n            hi=max(p, p*math.exp(w))  # rough\n            lo=min(p, p*math.exp(-w))\n            # better: brownian bridge style\n            # use start and end\n            mx=max(mx, hi)\n            mn=min(mn, lo)\n        for b in barriers_up:\n            if mx>=b: up_hits[b]+=1\n        for b in barriers_dn:\n            if mn<=b: dn_hits[b]+=1\n    print('UP', {b: round(up_hits[b]/n,3) for b in barriers_up})\n    print('DN', {b: round(dn_hits[b]/n,3) for b in barriers_dn})\n\nprint('daily levels 22h')\nsim_hit(22, 83638, [84000,85000], [83000,82000])\n\n# 4h candle remaining ~2 hours, need end >= 83331\n# simulate end price\nup=0\nfor i in range(N):\n    p=83638\n    for h in range(2):\n        p*=math.exp(random.gauss(mu, sig))\n    if p>=83331: up+=1\nprint('P(end>=83331) after 2h', round(up/N,3))\n\n# SPY: 4 days, spot 778.10, daily sig ~0.7% but CPI day bigger\n# use mixture\ndef spy():\n    # barriers\n    lows=[765,770,775]\n    highs=[780,785]\n    hitl={b:0 for b in lows}\n    hith={b:0 for b in highs}\n    # daily sigs Tue 0.0065, Wed CPI 0.011, Thu 0.009, Fri 0.0065\n    sigs=[0.0065,0.011,0.009,0.0065]\n    drift=0.0003\n    for i in range(N):\n        p=778.10\n        mn=p; mx=p\n        for s in sigs:\n            o=p\n            r=random.gauss(drift, s)\n            p=o*math.exp(r)\n            # intraday high/low: range factor\n            # empirical HL is about 0.8-1.2 * |move| plus base\n            base=abs(random.gauss(0, s*0.55))\n            hi=max(o,p)*math.exp(base)\n            lo=min(o,p)*math.exp(-base)\n            mx=max(mx, hi)\n            mn=min(mn, lo)\n        for b in lows:\n            if mn<=b: hitl[b]+=1\n        for b in highs:\n            if mx>=b: hith[b]+=1\n    print('SPY low', {b: round(hitl[b]/N,3) for b in lows})\n    print('SPY high', {b: round(hith[b]/N,3) for b in highs})\nspy()\nPY","description":"Simulate BTC and SPY barrier probabilities"},"content":[],"locations":[]}
